title: stizolobium spurium
intro: Stizolobium spurium, commonly known as Cowhage or Luffa purinans, is a plant species in the legume family that is native to tropical regions of Asia and Africa. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, due to its therapeutic actions of demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and anti-asthmatic properties. The bioactive constituents of Stizolobium spurium include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Stizolobium spurium for medicinal purposes.
